original_test_intent: Exercise exactly 10,000 approved PCIe device D3 entry/exit transitions on the mapped GB-NV-PVP endpoint and prove each cycle reaches the intended D3 state, wakes to the accepted functional and link state within deadline, and produces no device, PCIe, GPU, host, or platform error.
original_method: Approve D3hot versus D3cold, the controlling function and power-resource topology, endpoint/link scope, entry quiesce, wake source, functional-restoration, latency, and error contract; baseline policy and health; durably record each numbered D-state request, confirmed state/resource condition, wake, enumeration/link restoration, driver/function readiness, and error deltas before the next cycle; stop on first anomaly and recover out of band.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE approves D3 state, power-resource and wake semantics; an operator isolates the SUT, watches out-of-band state, and owns recovery if the function, GPU, link, or host does not return.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual D3 configuration with compatible firmware and driver
Exact PCI function, root-port/bridge/retimer/endpoint/GPU, sibling, and power-resource topology
D3hot/D3cold state, quiesce, entry, wake source, enumeration/link/driver/function restoration, and latency contract
10,000-cycle count, durable storage, error-delta, abort, final-policy, and recovery rules
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production SUT and explicit 10,000-transition approval
No unsaved workload, all endpoint consumers quiesced, and verified out-of-band console
Do not force D3cold or remove a shared power resource without an approved topology and recovery plan
Stop on failed entry/wake, missing or unhealthy function, link loss/downtraining, driver bind failure, new AER, GPU/host reset, thermal/power anomaly, tool fault, or evidence gap
No counter clearing, blind retry, forced rebind, or unapproved policy mutation
agent_execution_scope: Validate D3 capability, function/power topology, baseline, interlocks, and ledger
Run only the approved D-state entry/exit and wake method
Commit D-state, resource, wake, enumeration/link, driver/function, latency, and error results before the next cycle
Correlate endpoint function with GPU, link, host, BMC, thermal, and power health
Do not infer D3hot/D3cold, cut shared power, continue after fault, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve D3 state/mechanism, function and power-resource scope, and 10,000-cycle risk
Define quiesce, entry, wake, latency, link, driver/function, and error acceptance
Own first-fault disposition, policy restoration, and recovery
Review the full ledger and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It names the vendor tool family but omits D3hot/D3cold and power/wake/function semantics; a final lspci/dmesg sweep cannot prove 10,000 successful power-state entries and complete functional recoveries.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned D3 configuration with an atomic cycle ledger and an interlock blocking cycle N+1 until N proves intended D-state/resource condition, wake completion, enumeration/link/driver/function restoration, latency, and acceptable error deltas.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: LTSSM, exactly 10,000 D3 transitions, no-error acceptance, no bundle, and 60/1440-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: INTERLOCKED 10,000x PCIE D3 POWER STATE SOAK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each D3 cycle as an endpoint power transaction covering quiesce, state/resource entry, wake, link and driver/function restoration, latency, and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines D3 variant, power-resource blast radius, function quiesce/readiness, wake path, evidence durability, aborts, restoration, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final enumerated link cannot prove D3 entry, device-power removal, driver/function recovery, missed cycles, or transient wake and AER failures.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong D3 or power-resource control can remove shared devices, corrupt active work, lose the GPU/function, hang the driver, or require host-level recovery.

project_override_considerations: A function-level D3hot method must not be credited as D3cold coverage, and a link retrain must not substitute for a device D-state transition. Setup, retries, incomplete wakes, forced rebinds, or unproven function readiness do not count.
expected_evidence: Pinned tool/configuration, function/link/power-resource topology, supported D states, and initial policy
Approved quiesce, D-state/resource, wake, latency, enumeration/link/driver/function/error contract
Monotonic 1-10000 lossless ledger with state entry, wake, restoration, latency, and cycle disposition
Correlated PCI power/link/AER, driver/GPU function, dmesg/journal/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power evidence
First-fault recovery or clean restored policy and final endpoint/GPU/host state, followed by engineer verdict

review_improvement: Preserves all 10,000 D3 cycles while requiring proof that the device function and its consumers recover, not merely that the PCIe link is visible at the end.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PCI function in D3hot can retain auxiliary power and configuration access, while D3cold can remove power and require a materially different wake, enumeration, and driver recovery path. Neither is equivalent to an L1 transition or simple retrain. Consequently a valid cycle must identify the D-state and power-resource condition, prove consumers were quiesced, then show the function, link, driver, and workload-facing health returned within deadline. Later recovery can hide a transient lost function, so durable per-cycle evidence and first-fault inhibition are required.
